## Background

I worked with Nija Shi and Guillaume Brat in the Intelligent Systems Division on a project management tool to organize digital mission requirements, documents, and artifacts.

## What I Did

-   Developed a semantic search system, used on 3 missions, that analyzes 2,000+ project documents and retrieves critical evidence for reviews ([more on this project](../../research/nasa-semantic-search/index.qmd))
-   Expedited NASA's document auditing process by 3+ months using deep learning & NLP, automating text retrieval and adding a question answering tool to a project management dashboard
-   Improved the correct search retrieval rate by 30+% by fine-tuning BERT transformer language models to better represent phrases & acronyms commonly used at NASA
-   Designed ETL and search pipelines with an Elasticsearch (NoSQL) database, connected to a front-end dashboard built with NodeJS, React, & the Haystack REST API
